summary: Out-of-distribution length generalization, namely to extrapolate a task from short to longer context, has been studied intensively for transformers. Here we focus on distance generalization, which probes performance when inter-token distances are changed between training and inference, while keeping a fixed context length. We construct two synthetic delay copy tasks, both involving finite distances between source and recall, where tokens are copied either fully or selectively, and test models on delays unseen during training. We address three questions: (A) Do positional encoding schemes such as RoPE and ALiBi improve distance resolution relative to no positional encoding (NoPE)? (B) How does data diversity, the number of inter-token distances seen in training, affect performance? (C) When is distance transfer learning positive or negative? We present a thorough investigation, finding that it is paramount to improve our understanding of the underlying mechanisms.
title: Distance generalization in transformers: why bother with positional encoding?
title_translated: Transformer中的距离泛化：为何要使用位置编码？
summary_translated: 分布外长度泛化，即从短上下文外推到更长上下文的任务，已在Transformer模型中得到广泛研究。本文聚焦于距离泛化，探究在训练与推理阶段词元间距离发生变化但上下文长度固定时的模型性能表现。我们构建了两个合成的延迟复制任务，均涉及源词元与回忆词元之间的有限距离，且词元被完全或选择性地复制，并在训练中未见过的延迟条件下测试模型。我们提出三个问题：(A) 诸如RoPE和ALiBi等位置编码方案是否相比无位置编码（NoPE）提升了距离分辨能力？(B) 数据多样性（训练中经历的词元间距离数量）如何影响性能？(C) 距离迁移学习何时为正向或负向？我们进行了深入调查，发现理解其底层机制至关重要。

summary: As Speech Large Language Models (speech-LLMs) become increasingly multilingual, Arabic remains significantly underrepresented, highlighting the need for dedicated infrastructure to train and evaluate Arabic speech-LLMs. To address this gap, we introduce Nuha-Speech, a comprehensive initiative to develop general-purpose Arabic speech-LLMs spanning dataset construction, model training, and systematic evaluation. Specifically, we constructed a large-scale Arabic Speech Question-Answering (SQA) corpus comprising over 1.5 million training samples to allow instruction tuning over a broad range of core speech tasks. Then, the corpus was used for supervised fine-tuning based on Qwen-Omni model variants at different scales. Finally, we designed an evaluation framework featuring diverse tasks and tailored metrics. Through this work, we aim to establish foundational infrastructures for Arabic Speech-LLMs under constraints imposed by limited Arabic speech resources.
title: Nuha-Speech: Building General-Purpose Arabic Speech-LLMs
title_translated: Nuha-Speech：构建通用阿拉伯语语音大语言模型
summary_translated: 随着语音大语言模型（speech-LLMs）日益多语言化，阿拉伯语仍显著缺乏代表性，凸显了建立专门基础设施以训练和评估阿拉伯语语音大语言模型的必要性。为填补这一空白，我们推出了Nuha-Speech项目，涵盖数据集构建、模型训练和系统化评估，致力于开发通用型阿拉伯语语音大语言模型。具体而言，我们构建了一个大规模阿拉伯语语音问答（SQA）语料库，包含超过150万条训练样本，支持对核心语音任务进行广泛的指令微调。随后，基于Qwen-Omni模型的不同规模变体，利用该语料库进行监督微调。最后，我们设计了一套包含多样化任务和定制指标的评估框架。本工作旨在在阿拉伯语语音资源有限的约束下，建立阿拉伯语语音大语言模型的基础性基础设施。

summary: Large language models generate fluent text that can contain unfaithful claims -- a phenomenon known as hallucination. We present a multi-signal detection pipeline combining fine-tuned DeBERTa-v3 classification, Monte Carlo (MC) Dropout uncertainty quantification, and temperature-scaled calibration for response-level hallucination detection. Evaluated on the HaluEval benchmark, our pipeline achieves F1=0.915 and AUROC=0.977 on general-domain tasks, with per-task F1 scores of 0.97 (QA), 0.96 (Summarization), and 0.82 (Dialogue). MC Dropout inference further improves accuracy to 93.2%. A context ablation study confirms the model performs genuine entailment reasoning rather than exploiting surface patterns, with summarization F1 dropping 24% when knowledge context is removed. Learning curve analysis reveals that 25% of training data captures 77% of full-data performance. Beyond detection, we apply Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) to a Qwen2.5-0.5B generator, reducing its hallucination rate from 85.5% to 37.7% (55.9% relative reduction) as measured by our detector. Cross-domain evaluation on the SciFact biomedical benchmark shows that general-domain training transfers poorly (F1=0.52), motivating domain-specific fine-tuning. PubMedBERT fine-tuned on SciFact achieves F1=0.63 and AUROC=0.81, demonstrating that domain-matched pre-training is the strongest adaptation strategy. Code and models are available at this https URL
title: Domain-Specific Hallucination Detection in Large Language Models
title_translated: 大语言模型中的领域特定幻觉检测
summary_translated: 大语言模型生成流畅文本，但可能包含不忠实的陈述——这种现象被称为幻觉。我们提出一种多信号检测流水线，结合微调的DeBERTa-v3分类器、蒙特卡洛（MC）Dropout不确定性量化以及温度缩放校准，实现响应级别的幻觉检测。在HaluEval基准上评估，该流水线在通用领域任务中达到F1=0.915，AUROC=0.977，各任务F1得分分别为：问答（0.97）、摘要（0.96）、对话（0.82）。MC Dropout推理进一步将准确率提升至93.2%。上下文消融实验表明，模型执行的是真实的蕴含推理而非依赖表面模式，当知识上下文被移除时，摘要F1下降24%。学习曲线分析显示，25%的训练数据即可捕获77%的全数据性能。除了检测，我们还应用直接偏好优化（DPO）对Qwen2.5-0.5B生成器进行优化，使其幻觉率从85.5%降至37.7%（相对减少55.9%）。在SciFact生物医学基准上的跨领域评估显示，通用领域训练的迁移效果差（F1=0.52），这促使采用领域特定微调。在SciFact上微调的PubMedBERT达到F1=0.63和AUROC=0.81，表明领域匹配的预训练是最佳适应策略。代码与模型已公开。

summary: A language model normally begins training with random word embeddings: whatever 'banana' means must be learned from training corpora. I implement St. Augustine's picture of word learning, meaning by ostension, for a small masked language model (DeBERTa) trained on 10M words: before training, visually grounded tokens receive embeddings derived from the image regions they label; other tokens start random. Visual initialization leaves a measurable imprint that lasts until the end of training. At the same time, the effect remains invisible under most BabyLM benchmarks, which probe abstract grammatical knowledge: visual initialization does not affect performance there. The only zero-shot exception is object-property knowledge (COMPS, Misra et al. 2023), where seeding helps in every configuration. To follow up on this result, I build a corpus-tailored version of the Visual-Property Swap benchmark (Lin et al., 2026), which tests color, material, size, and shape knowledge, with per-item training frequency and seeded status. Here, vision-seeded models have a persistent, seed- replicated advantage, confined to the seeded words. As a causal test, I show that synthetic grounding of previously unseeded words transfers the advantage to exactly those words. Function words and abstract vocabulary also receive strong visual seeds and retain them throughout training, and the training objective draws on them: held-out mask-prediction loss falls for these words in every seed. However, no benchmark I run registers this. What evaluation would pick this up remains an open question.
title: Augustinian BabyLM: What Ostensive Definition Can and Cannot Teach a Small Language Model
title_translated: 奥古斯丁婴儿语言模型：示范定义能且不能教会小型语言模型什么
summary_translated: 语言模型通常以随机词嵌入开始训练：'香蕉'的含义必须从训练语料库中学习。我为一个在1000万词上训练的小型掩码语言模型（DeBERTa）实现了圣奥古斯丁关于通过示范学习词义的观点：在训练前，视觉锚定的词元接收来自其所标注图像区域的嵌入；其他词元则保持随机初始化。视觉初始化在训练结束时仍留下可测量的痕迹。然而，在大多数婴儿语言模型（BabyLM）基准测试中，这种影响不可见，这些测试主要考察抽象语法知识：视觉初始化并未影响此类任务的表现。唯一的零样本例外是物体属性知识（COMPS，Misra等，2023），在所有配置中种子初始化均有帮助。为进一步验证此结果，我构建了一个针对语料库定制的视觉属性交换基准（Lin等，2026），用于测试颜色、材质、大小和形状知识，并记录每项内容的训练频率和种子状态。结果显示，视觉种子模型在种子词上具有持久且可复制的优势。作为因果测试，我展示了对先前未种子化的词元进行合成接地后，该优势恰好转移到这些词元。功能词和抽象词汇也获得了强视觉种子并贯穿整个训练过程，且训练目标依赖于它们：在所有种子设置中，这些词元的保留掩码预测损失均下降。然而，我所运行的所有基准均未捕捉到这一现象。何种评估能够揭示这一点，仍是开放问题。

summary: Truth and evidence-based communication provide important foundations for democratic governance, accountability, and collective decision-making. Prior work shows that evidence-oriented language in US congressional floor speeches has declined since the mid-1970s, alongside broader changes in legislative productivity and polarization. This study shifts the analysis from congressional sessions to individual members of Congress to examine whether epistemic orientation varies systematically across legislators and whether it relates to political behavior and legislative effectiveness. Using the Evidence-Minus-Intuition (EMI) score, we measure the relative prevalence of evidence-oriented versus intuition-oriented language in congressional floor speeches and Twitter posts. We link these measures to legislator-level data on ideology, institutional position, communication context, and Legislative Effectiveness Score (LES). The results show that more ideologically extreme members use less evidence-oriented language on the congressional floor. EMI also exhibits cross-platform consistency with members who use more evidence-oriented language in floor speeches also being more evidence-oriented on Twitter, although EMI is lower on Twitter overall. Finally, EMI in congressional speeches is positively associated with individual legislative effectiveness, even after accounting for ideology and extensive political, institutional, demographic, topical, and communication volume controls. These findings suggest that evidence-oriented language is not only an aggregate feature of congressional discourse but also a meaningful attribute of individual-level legislative communication and effectiveness.
title: Epistemic orientation predicts legislative effectiveness among members of the US Congress
title_translated: 认知取向预测美国国会议员的立法有效性
summary_translated: 真理与基于证据的沟通是民主治理、问责制和集体决策的重要基础。以往研究表明，自20世纪70年代中期以来，美国国会演讲中基于证据的语言呈下降趋势，同时立法生产力和极化程度也发生广泛变化。本研究将分析从国会会议层面转向个体议员，探讨认知取向是否在议员之间系统性差异，并与其政治行为及立法有效性相关。我们使用‘证据减去直觉’（EMI）评分，衡量国会演讲和推文中基于证据语言与直觉语言的相对比例。我们将这些指标与议员层面的意识形态、机构地位、沟通环境以及立法有效性评分（LES）数据关联。结果表明，意识形态极端的议员在国会演讲中较少使用基于证据的语言。EMI在不同平台间具有一致性：在演讲中更倾向使用证据语言的议员，在推特上也更倾向于使用证据语言，尽管整体上推特上的EMI值较低。最终，即使在控制意识形态及大量政治、制度、人口统计、主题和沟通量因素后，国会演讲中的EMI仍与个人立法有效性呈正相关。这些发现表明，基于证据的语言不仅是国会话语的宏观特征，也是个体议员立法沟通与效能的有意义属性。

summary: Language identification in code-mixed text, largely observed in social media, is highly essential when users frequently switch between multiple languages within a single utterance. Accurately identifying the languages of code-mixed tokens becomes an urgent necessity. Traditional language identification models, designed for monolingual text, are not well suited for token-level language identification in code-mixed settings. We formulate the task as a sequence labeling problem and fine-tune contextual transformer-based models MuRIL and XLM-RoBERTa best suited for Indian languages. We evaluate these systems on three different data configurations (Hindi, Gujarati, and Bengali) to predict language labels for individual tokens. We release a benchmark for language identification in code-mixed tokens with manually annotated test sets. We propose two approaches of code-mixed generation using parallel sentences of three languages. The trained models demonstrate the effectiveness of contextual embeddings for token-level language identification in multilingual social media text. For reproducibility and to facilitate future research, we publicly release our fine-tuned models.
title: IndicTriMix: Developing Language Identification Datasets and Models for Tri-Language Code-Mixing
title_translated: IndicTriMix：面向三语混用的语种识别数据集与模型的构建
summary_translated: 在社交媒体中频繁出现的语种混用文本中的语种识别至关重要，因为用户常在同一语句内频繁切换多种语言。准确识别混用文本中每个词元的语言成为迫切需求。传统语种识别模型专为单语文本设计，不适用于混用场景下的词元级语种识别。我们将其建模为序列标注任务，并微调了最适合印度语言的上下文Transformer模型MuRIL和XLM-RoBERTa。我们在三种不同数据配置（印地语、古吉拉特语和孟加拉语）上评估这些系统，以预测单个词元的语言标签。我们发布了首个针对混用词元语种识别的手动标注测试集基准。我们提出了两种基于三种语言平行句子的混用生成方法。训练后的模型展示了上下文嵌入在多语种社交媒体文本中词元级语种识别的有效性。为确保可复现性并促进未来研究，我们公开发布了微调后的模型。

summary: Cardiovascular screening models trained on national health surveys routinely report areas under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) near 0.89. We asked whether that accuracy reflects learning or target leakage, whether tabular foundation models change the answer, and whether the properties deployment requires survive joint examination. We benchmarked ten classifiers spanning linear, tree-ensemble, neural, glass-box, and tabular foundation classes for prevalent myocardial infarction in 442,067 respondents of the 2022 Behavioral Risk Factor Surveillance System across five feature tiers of decreasing leakage risk. Each was audited for discrimination, calibration, fairness at an explicit screening threshold, conformal coverage, explanation faithfulness, and inference cost, then applied -- models and thresholds frozen -- to 430,755 respondents of 2023. Removing two post-diagnostic features cost every model 0.049-0.051 AUROC, collapsing the field into a 0.0045-wide band. The glass-box explainable boosting machine was non-inferior to every alternative within a pre-specified 0.005 margin while scoring the cohort roughly 104 times faster than the strongest foundation model. One threshold detected 75.4% of women's infarctions against 89.0% of men's; editing the model's shape functions reduced the gap to 0.010. Marginal conformal prediction gave 0.86 coverage to men and 0.82 to adults over 60; Mondrian calibration repaired every stratum. Frozen models transported within 0.002 AUROC. Reported headroom in this literature is a property of the feature set, not the learner. Transparency cost nothing measurable and made fairness repair and uncertainty conditioning directly auditable. Evaluation practice, not model capacity, is the binding constraint.
title: Target leakage, not model class, explains reported accuracy in survey-based cardiovascular screening: a leakage-tiered audit of glass-box and tabular foundation models
title_translated: 目标泄露而非模型类别解释了基于调查的心血管筛查报告准确性：对透明模型与表格基础模型的泄露分层审计
summary_translated: 基于国家健康调查训练的心血管筛查模型通常报告受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUROC）接近0.89。我们探究该准确性是否反映学习能力或目标泄露，表格基础模型是否会改变结论，以及部署所需属性是否能在联合检验中保持。我们在2022年行为风险因素监测系统中442,067名受访者中，对十类分类器（涵盖线性、树集成、神经网络、透明模型及表格基础模型）在五个递减泄露风险特征层级上进行了基准测试。每项模型均经过歧视性、校准性、公平性（在明确筛查阈值下）、保真度覆盖、解释可信度和推理成本的审计，随后在2023年430,755名受访者的数据上应用（模型与阈值冻结）。移除两个诊断后特征使所有模型的AUROC下降0.049-0.051，使整个领域收敛至仅0.0045宽的区间。透明可解释的提升机模型在预设0.005范围内优于所有其他模型，且推理速度比最强的基础模型快约104倍。一个阈值检测到75.4%女性心肌梗死病例，而男性为89.0%；调整模型形状函数后差距缩小至0.010。边际置信预测对男性提供0.86覆盖率，对60岁以上成人提供0.82；Mondrian校准修复了所有子群体。冻结模型迁移时AUROC变化不超过0.002。该文献中报告的性能余量是特征集的属性，而非学习器本身所致。透明性无显著成本，且使公平性修复与不确定性条件可直接审计。评估实践而非模型容量才是关键约束。

summary: Automatic speech recognition (ASR) systems and audio language models (audio LMs) now report low error rates on monolingual benchmarks, but their behavior on code switched speech in low resource, diacritic rich languages remains poorly characterized. We present a switch aware evaluation of eleven modern systems (six ASR models and five audio LMs) on English Yoruba code-switched speech, using a deterministic 2000 utterance evaluation set and a shared scoring pipeline. Beyond word error rate (WER), we report switch localized diagnostics: a switch entry token error rate (SETER), windowed switch point error rates, language specific error rates, and a diacritic insensitive WER. Our central finding is that aggregate WER hides code switching behavior. The best system by WER (an ASR model) is statistically indistinguishable from a leading audio LM on WER, yet the audio LM is significantly better on every switch localized metric. Across faithful systems, Yoruba token recognition collapses (error 0.97 for almost all systems) while English tokens are recognized far better, and errors concentrate sharply at switches into Yoruba. Several generative audio LMs fail as exact transcribers, producing translation, verbosity, and prompt leakage that are strongly prompt dependent. We release manifests, metric implementations, and evaluation scripts to support reproducible, switch aware benchmarking for African code switched speech.
title: Beyond Word Error Rate: A Switch Aware Evaluation of ASR and Audio Language Models on English Yoruba Code-Switched Speech
comment: Accepted to IEEE Speech Language Tecnology
title_translated: 超越词错误率：面向英语-约鲁巴语混用语音的ASR与音频语言模型的切换感知评估
summary_translated: 自动语音识别（ASR）系统和音频语言模型（音频LM）在单语基准上已报告低错误率，但其在低资源、带变音符号丰富的语言中的混用语音表现仍缺乏充分刻画。我们对十一款现代系统（六款ASR模型和五款音频LM）在英语-约鲁巴语混用语音上进行了切换感知评估，采用确定性的2000条语音样本评估集和共享评分流程。除了词错误率（WER），我们还报告了切换定位诊断指标：切换入口词元错误率（SETER）、窗口化切换点错误率、语言特定错误率以及对变音符号不敏感的WER。核心发现是：聚合WER掩盖了混用行为。按WER排名最佳的ASR模型与领先的音频LM在WER上统计无差异，但音频LM在所有切换定位指标上均显著更优。在忠实系统中，约鲁巴词元识别严重崩溃（几乎所有系统错误率高达0.97），而英语词元识别良好，且错误高度集中于进入约鲁巴语的切换点。多个生成式音频LM作为精确转录器表现失败，产生翻译、冗余和提示泄露，且高度依赖提示内容。我们发布了数据清单、指标实现代码和评估脚本，以支持非洲混用语音的可复现、切换感知基准测试。

summary: Large language models are superseded every few quarters; clinical evidence takes years. We asked whether medical research is keeping pace with the systems it evaluates. PubMed returned 11,628 records for January 2023 to June 2026 across fourteen clinical domains, growing 45-fold; 2.5% used a randomised, controlled or prospective design. Evaluation lag, from a study's newest named model release to its own publication, widened from 1.33 to 6.08 quarters. Because discontinued models age mechanically, we benchmarked this against a counterfactual holding model composition fixed: migration to newer systems offset only 56% of the drift (95% CI 50-65). Randomised trials evaluated models a median 4.6 quarters older than other designs (P = 3 x 10^-19), yet among studies naming a model still under development no design differed from any other; 62% of randomised trials evaluated a discontinued family. Rigour and currency are in tension, and that tension reflects model selection rather than research timelines.
title: The widening evaluation gap in medical large language model research 2023 to 2026
title_translated: 2023至2026年医学大语言模型研究中的评估差距持续扩大
summary_translated: 大语言模型每几个季度就被新模型取代；而临床证据需要数年时间。我们探讨医学研究是否跟得上其所评估的系统进展。PubMed检索显示，2023年1月至2026年6月间，十四类临床领域共返回11,628条记录，增长了45倍；其中仅2.5%采用随机对照或前瞻性设计。从研究中新命名模型发布到论文发表之间的评估滞后时间，从1.33个季度扩大至6.08个季度。由于停用模型会随时间自然老化，我们将其与固定模型构成的反事实情景进行对比：迁移到新系统仅抵消了56%的漂移（95%置信区间50%-65%）。随机试验评估的模型平均比其他设计老4.6个季度（P = 3×10^-19），但在命名仍在开发中的模型的研究中，各种设计之间无显著差异；62%的随机试验评估的是已停用的模型家族。严谨性与时效性存在张力，而这种张力源于模型选择，而非研究时间线本身。

summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to analyze and rewrite news, yet current framing studies mainly evaluate generation, detection, or whether rewritten text appears more neutral. They do not directly show whether a model can undo a known framing transformation while keeping the facts fixed. We introduce a controlled inversion test over three established textual realizations of framing: evaluative lexis, agency realization, and information salience. Across 60 news articles and three intervention strengths, this yields 540 paired variants with preserved atomic facts and recorded edits. Across Qwen, DeepSeek, and Kimi, factual preservation remains near 0.84, whereas intervention reversal is 0.044--0.068. Even when both framing type and direction are recognized correctly, pooled reversal reaches 0.071. These results reveal a clear separation between factual fidelity, framing recognition, and framing inversion: recognizing how an article is framed does not imply that the framing can be undone.
title: Recognizing Is Not Reversing: A Controlled Inversion Test of Fact-Preserving News Framing
title_translated: 识别不等于逆转：事实保留新闻框架的受控逆向测试
summary_translated: 大型语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地被用于分析和重写新闻，但当前的框架研究主要评估生成、检测或重写文本是否显得更中立，而未直接验证模型能否在保持事实不变的前提下撤销已知的框架转换。我们引入了一种受控逆向测试，覆盖三种公认的文本框架实现方式：评价性词汇、主体实现和信息显著性。通过对60篇新闻文章和三种干预强度进行测试，生成了540对具有原子事实保留和编辑记录的变体。在Qwen、DeepSeek和Kimi模型上，事实保留率维持在约0.84，而干预逆转率仅为0.044–0.068。即使框架类型和方向均被正确识别，综合逆转率也仅达0.071。结果揭示了事实保真度、框架识别与框架逆转之间存在明显分离：识别出一篇文章的框架，并不意味着能够将其逆转。

summary: Per-layer differential privacy (DP) clipping improves gradient fidelity in federated learning by allocating per-matrix clipping budgets proportional to parameter count. We show that this recipe breaks for speech large language models (speech-LLMs), when the acoustic encoder and the language decoder differ by an order of magnitude in update norm. Single-pool per-layer methods suffer \emph{cross-component budget collapse}, dragging word error rate (WER) far from flat global clipping or collapsing training entirely. When the norm imbalance is milder, adaptive single-pool methods partially recover, confirming that collapse severity scales with the inter-component norm ratio. We empirically diagnose the root cause across six per-layer methods and three speech-LLM architectures. We then propose \emph{$\alpha$-split}, a two-pool allocation that normalises encoder and LLM parameters into independent pools, and show that joint $\ell_2$ sensitivity and the original $(\varepsilon,\delta)$-DP guarantee are unchanged. At architecture-calibrated $\alpha$, our method recovers WER utility compared to flat DP, while granting the encoder $4.47{\times}$ tighter per-component noise protection against speaker voice-based gradient-inversion attacks at only $+2.6\%$ LLM noise overhead.
title: Component-Aware Differential Privacy for Federated Multilingual Speech-LLMs
title_translated: 面向联邦多语言语音大模型的组件感知差分隐私
summary_translated: 每层差分隐私（DP）裁剪通过按参数量比例分配每矩阵的裁剪预算，提升了联邦学习中的梯度保真度。我们发现，当声学编码器与语言解码器在更新范数上相差一个数量级时，这一方法在语音大语言模型（speech-LLMs）中失效。单池每层方法遭受‘跨组件预算崩溃’，导致词错误率（WER）远偏离全局固定裁剪，或完全导致训练崩溃。当范数不平衡较轻时，自适应单池方法部分恢复性能，证实崩溃严重性与组件间范数比成正比。我们对六种每层方法和三种语音LLM架构进行了实证诊断，根因分析表明该问题源于组件间的范数失衡。随后提出$α$-split方法，采用双池分配策略，将编码器与LLM参数分别归入独立池，并证明联合$ε_2$敏感性和原始$(ε,δ)$-DP保证不变。在架构校准的$α$下，该方法在WER效用上恢复至固定DP水平，同时使编码器在仅增加2.6% LLM噪声开销的前提下，获得4.47倍更严格的针对基于说话人声音的梯度反演攻击的组件级噪声保护。

summary: Allowing large language models (LLMs) to retrieve information from a set of trusted documents can increase reliability and reduce hallucination. However, recent work has demonstrated that retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) can have unintended side effects on the overall safety of the generated responses, when prompted for harmful or dangerous content. A clearer understanding of the mechanisms leading to this result is needed, as increasing numbers of end users turn to RAG to incorporate corporate documents and knowledge bases into LLM-based systems. We introduce RAG-Safety-Bench, a benchmark to measure the safety impact of RAG on LLM models. By removing the confounding effect of retriever quality, and cleanly separating the problem into four conditions -- non-RAG, RAG with an oracle document containing the answer to the harmful request, RAG with documents related to the harmful request but without the specific answer, and RAG with random, safe documents -- the benchmark isolates the impacts of different factors in the observed safety degradation. We report results across five open-source LLMs, showing an inverse relationship between benign and unsafe capability, strong evidence that baseline safety guardrails do not lead to downstream safety guarantees in the RAG case, and model-specific support for previous findings that even benign documents can lead to unsafe generation in retrieval-enabled systems.
title: RAG-Safety-Bench: Reliable Evaluation of Retrieval-Augmented LLM Safety
title_translated: RAG-Safety-Bench：检索增强型大模型安全性的可靠评估
summary_translated: 允许大语言模型（LLMs）从一组可信文档中检索信息可提升生成可靠性并减少幻觉。然而，近期研究表明，当被提示生成有害或危险内容时，检索增强生成（RAG）可能对生成结果的整体安全性产生意外负面影响。需要更清晰地理解导致这一现象的机制，因为越来越多终端用户正将RAG用于整合企业文档和知识库到基于LLM的系统中。本文提出RAG-Safety-Bench，一个用于衡量RAG对LLM安全性影响的基准测试。通过消除检索器质量的混杂影响，并将问题清晰划分为四种条件——非RAG、RAG使用包含答案的“理想”文档、RAG使用相关但不含具体答案的文档、以及RAG使用随机且安全的文档——该基准隔离了不同因素在观察到的安全性退化中的作用。我们在五个开源LLM上报告结果，发现良性能力与不安全能力之间存在反向关系；强证据表明，基线安全防护措施无法在RAG场景中带来下游安全性保障；此外，还提供了模型特定的支持，验证了即使良性文档也可能在检索启用系统中引发不安全生成的先前发现。

summary: Large language model serving costs scale directly with output sequence length, yet standard preference alignment often inflates response verbosity without improving utility. We study whether the parameterization of post-training updates affects generation length: low-rank subspaces alter sequence length without modifying the alignment loss. We present LOCUS, a method that selects a task-aware low-rank adaptation subspace to minimize output-token cost subject to a utility constraint. Within this subspace, post-training retains the native preference objective with a frozen backbone. Across Anthropic HH-RLHF dialogue preferences, we evaluate two $\sim$3B decoder backbones, Pythia-2.8B and Qwen2.5-3B, against protocol-matched full-parameter DPO and DrDPO branches and the released SamPO checkpoint. LOCUS reduces continuation length by up to 39.84\% on Pythia-2.8B and by 14.87--17.58\% on Qwen2.5-3B while updating only 0.24--0.28\% of model parameters, with no material change in the internal preference diagnostic.
title: LOCUS: Task-Aware Low-Rank Post-Training for Token-Efficient Language Generation
title_translated: LOCUS：面向任务感知的低秩后训练以实现高效token生成
summary_translated: 大型语言模型的服务成本随输出序列长度直接增长，而标准偏好对齐常会无谓增加响应冗长度却未提升实际效用。我们研究后训练更新的参数化方式是否影响生成长度：低秩子空间可在不改变对齐损失的情况下调整序列长度。我们提出LOCUS方法，选择一种任务感知的低秩适配子空间，在满足效用约束的前提下最小化输出token成本。在此子空间内，后训练保留原生偏好目标，且骨干网络冻结。我们在Anthropic HH-RLHF对话偏好数据集上，对两个约30亿参数的解码器骨干（Pythia-2.8B和Qwen2.5-3B）进行评估，对比协议匹配的全参数DPO和DrDPO分支以及发布的SamPO检查点。LOCUS在Pythia-2.8B上将续写长度降低最多达39.84%，在Qwen2.5-3B上降低14.87%–17.58%，同时仅更新模型参数的0.24%–0.28%，内部偏好诊断指标无显著变化。

summary: This paper details the Eloquence team's approach to Task 2 of the 2nd MLC-SLM challenge at Interspeech 2026, which involves multilingual Multiple-Choice Question Answering (MCQA) across 21 languages. Three approaches are explored. First, we fine-tune Voxtral-Mini-3B via LoRA with cross-lingual data augmentation, ASR transcript augmentation and timestamp-aware audio cropping, achieving 0.72 macro-accuracy on evaluation Phase 2. Second, we apply multimodal in-context learning (ICL) to the frozen Voxtral-24B model to correct a strong label bias, reaching 0.81, our best result. Third, a training-free retrieval system based on a three-layer voice-anchored memory combining acoustic identity, semantic content, and a knowledge graph achieves 0.68. All three systems substantially outperform the official baseline.
title: The Eloquence submission for Task 2 of the Interspeech 2026 MLC-SLM challenge
title_translated: Eloquence团队在Interspeech 2026 MLC-SLM挑战赛Task 2中的提交方案
summary_translated: 本文详细介绍了Eloquence团队在Interspeech 2026第二届MLC-SLM挑战赛Task 2中的方法，该任务涉及21种语言的多语言多项选择题问答（MCQA）。提出了三种方法：第一，通过LoRA微调Voxtral-Mini-3B模型，结合跨语言数据增强、ASR转录增强和时间戳感知音频裁剪，在评估阶段2达到0.72的宏平均准确率；第二，对冻结的Voxtral-24B模型应用多模态上下文学习（ICL）以纠正强烈的标签偏差，取得0.81的最佳成绩；第三，提出一种无需训练的检索系统，基于三层语音锚定记忆结构（融合声学身份、语义内容与知识图谱），达到0.68的准确率。三种系统均显著优于官方基线。

summary: On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD) has emerged as a popular paradigm for large language model (LLM) self-improvement, allowing models to act as their own teachers by leveraging privileged information such as ground-truth solutions. However, recent findings indicate that OPSD can severely degrade the performance of LLMs on complex reasoning tasks: By forcing the student to imitate an artificially confident reasoning trace conditioned on privileged information, OPSD inadvertently suppresses expressions of uncertainty and penalizes the exploratory, self-corrective behaviors required to solve challenging problems. To address this, we introduce Negative Self-Distillation (NSD), a new framework that optimizes LLMs by diverging from flawed reasoning rather than imitating privileged solutions. Instead of relying on ground-truth answers or external supervision, NSD uses the model itself to generate a question-specific negative condition (eg, acting as a ``careless reasoner'') and pushes the student's distribution away from this self-generated negative teacher. Naively applying unlearning objectives to achieve this divergence is problematic, as flawed reasoning tokens are confounded with basic linguistic tokens; indiscriminately penalizing both risks catastrophically degrading the model's foundational language capabilities. We resolve this by designing a dynamic gating mechanism that automatically identifies and isolates reasoning-critical tokens, ensuring gradient updates target only behavioral flaws while preserving the model's linguistic priors. Empirically, NSD consistently outperforms OPSD and other label-free, self-bootstrapping reinforcement learning (RL) baselines.
title: Negative Self-Distillation: Learning to Reason by Avoiding Flaws
title_translated: 负向自我蒸馏：通过避免缺陷来学习推理
summary_translated: 在策略自我蒸馏（OPSD）已成为大语言模型（LLM）自我改进的流行范式，使模型能利用诸如真实答案等特权信息作为自身教师。然而，近期研究发现，OPSD在复杂推理任务上会严重损害LLM性能：通过强制学生模仿依赖特权信息而人为自信的推理路径，OPSD无意中抑制了不确定性表达，并惩罚了解决难题所必需的探索性与自我修正行为。为解决此问题，我们提出负向自我蒸馏（NSD），一种通过偏离有缺陷的推理而非模仿特权解来优化LLM的新框架。NSD不依赖真实答案或外部监督，而是让模型自身生成特定问题的负向条件（如扮演‘粗心推理者’），并推动学生分布远离这一自生成的负向教师。直接应用去学习目标实现这种偏离存在风险，因为有缺陷的推理标记与基本语言标记混淆，盲目惩罚两者可能导致模型基础语言能力灾难性退化。我们通过设计动态门控机制自动识别并隔离推理关键标记，确保梯度更新仅针对行为缺陷，同时保留模型的语言先验。实验表明，NSD在各项指标上持续优于OPSD及其他无标签、自启动强化学习基线。

summary: We revisit Kashin-decomposition-based weight quantization for large language models and propose an improved algorithm with stronger convergence properties and structured, efficient orthogonal transforms. The method retains the core factorization of each weight into two components -- one with bounded infinity norm and the other with bounded infinity norm after an orthogonal transformation -- but replaces the dense random orthogonal matrix with a sign-randomized Discrete Cosine Transform (DCT), reducing the per-iteration cost from $\mathcal{O}(N^2)$ to $\mathcal{O}(N \log N)$. The proposed greedy algorithm with alternating updates guarantees the four-peak distribution required for stable 2-bit clustering of each factor and admits closed-form initialization of cluster centers, removing the multi-restart k-means bottleneck of prior work. Composed with OPTQ-style sequential error compensation and QuIP-style incoherence preprocessing, the resulting JAX pipeline is competitive with OPTQ, QuIP, QuIP-RG and a fine-tuning- and vector-quantization-free variant of QuIP# at 4-bit per channel on OPT, Llama-2 and Pythia, with favorable wall-clock scaling. The bounded-$\ell_\infty$ factorization is also notably robust: on stress configurations where QuIP variants diverge to four-digit perplexity (Pythia-6.9B) or abort with NaNs in LDL back-substitution (Mistral-7B), Kashin-DCT remains numerically stable and stays close to FP16 baseline. At inference time, each weight decomposes into two 2-bit factor codes per channel that are structurally suited to native-2-bit hardware.
title: Structured Transforms for Low-Overhead Quantization of Language Models
title_translated: 面向低开销量化语言模型的结构化变换
summary_translated: 我们重新审视基于Kashin分解的大型语言模型权重量化方法，并提出一种改进算法，具有更强的收敛性以及结构化、高效的正交变换。该方法保留了权重分解为两个分量的核心思想——一个分量具有有界无穷范数，另一个在正交变换后也具有有界无穷范数——但用符号随机化的离散余弦变换（DCT）替代了密集的随机正交矩阵，将每次迭代的成本从$\mathcal{O}(N^2)$降低到$\mathcal{O}(N \log N)$。所提出的带有交替更新的贪心算法保证了每个因子稳定进行2比特聚类所需的四峰分布，并支持聚类中心的闭式初始化，从而消除了先前工作中的多重启k-means瓶颈。结合OPTQ风格的顺序误差补偿和QuIP风格的非相干预处理，最终的JAX流水线在OPT、Llama-2和Pythia模型上以每通道4比特的量化水平，性能可与OPTQ、QuIP、QuIP-RG以及无微调和向量量化变体的QuIP#相媲美，且具有更优的时钟时间扩展性。有界-$\ell_\infty$分解也表现出显著鲁棒性：在压力配置下，当QuIP变体发散至四位困惑度（Pythia-6.9B）或在LDL回代中因NaN而中止（Mistral-7B）时，Kashin-DCT仍保持数值稳定，并接近FP16基线。推理时，每个权重分解为每通道两个2比特因子码，结构上适合原生2比特硬件。

summary: High-dimensional dense text embeddings and large language models face real obstacles in financial-disclosure analysis: context-window limits, hallucination risk, high computational cost, and the arbitrary rotation of vector spaces across independently trained models. We present a training-free, alignment-free framework for corporate intelligence built on deterministic sparse seed vectors. Hashing word strings into a fixed high-dimensional basis places all documents and all temporal epochs in a common coordinate system by construction, removing any need for training or alignment. Accumulating these seed vectors across sentence contexts yields corpus-specific semantic signatures that compose linearly, supporting sub-second document comparison, issuer fingerprinting, tracking of how an issuer's vocabulary shifts between filings, and thematic sentence extraction, all on ordinary CPU hardware. Demonstrating the approach on a multi-year corpus of SEC filings (10-K, 10-Q, 8-K), we show how material corporate events, among them Boeing's 737 MAX crisis, Intel's supply-chain disruptions, and Bunge's acquisition of Viterra, emerge as distinct, interpretable semantic profiles, each traceable to the exact source sentences that produced it, with no domain-specific training and no LLM inference.
title: A Training-Free, Alignment-Free Approach to Corporate Intelligence: Application to SEC Filings
title_translated: 一种无需训练、无需对齐的企业智能方法：应用于SEC文件分析
summary_translated: 高维稠密文本嵌入和大型语言模型在财务披露分析中面临真实挑战：上下文窗口限制、幻觉风险、高计算成本，以及独立训练模型间向量空间任意旋转的问题。我们提出一种无需训练、无需对齐的企业智能框架，基于确定性的稀疏种子向量构建。通过将词串哈希到固定高维基底，从构造上将所有文档和所有时间阶段置于同一坐标系中，彻底消除训练或对齐的需求。在句子上下文中累积这些种子向量，生成具有语义特性的文档签名，其线性组合特性支持亚秒级文档比较、发行人指纹识别、追踪发行人词汇随文件变化的趋势，以及主题句子提取，全部可在普通CPU硬件上实现。在多年期SEC文件（10-K、10-Q、8-K）语料库上的实证表明，诸如波音737 MAX危机、英特尔供应链中断、邦吉收购维特拉等重大企业事件，均能以清晰可解释的语义轮廓显现，且每项均可追溯至产生它的具体原文句子，无需领域特定训练，也无需使用大语言模型推理。

summary: Low-resource multilingual text-to-speech (TTS) systems have expanded language coverage, but their robustness under complex text inputs remains insufficiently diagnosed. Existing evaluations mainly focus on naturalness, speaker similarity, and content consistency using regular test sentences, while providing limited insight into how multilingual TTS systems fail when handling challenging inputs such as numbers, dates, named entities, long sentences, code-switched expressions, and punctuation-related structures. This paper proposes a complex-text robustness diagnosis framework for low-resource multilingual TTS. We evaluate robustness from three dimensions: content consistency, language consistency, and generation stability. A multilingual robustness testing scheme is designed for Thai, Vietnamese, Swahili, and Indonesian, covering ordinary sentences and multiple types of complex text inputs. We further introduce automatic diagnostic metrics, including character error rate, language identification accuracy, and duration abnormal rate. To support input-level risk analysis before speech generation, we propose a lightweight Text Risk Score (TRS), which estimates synthesis risk from interpretable text features without manual annotation or model training. Experiments on three representative multilingual TTS systems, including OmniVoice, VoxCPM2, and MMS-TTS, show that complex text inputs expose systematic failure patterns that are not fully reflected by ordinary short-sentence evaluation. Different systems exhibit distinct vulnerabilities in number normalization, named entity handling, long-text generation, and code-switched input processing. Furthermore, TRS shows a positive correlation with content errors and duration abnormalities, demonstrating its usefulness as a low-cost pre-synthesis indicator for complex-text risk diagnosis in low-resource multilingual TTS.
title: Complex-Text Robustness Evaluation and Failure Diagnosis for Low-Resource Multilingual Text-to-Speech
title_translated: 低资源多语言文本转语音的复杂文本鲁棒性评估与故障诊断
summary_translated: 低资源多语言文本转语音（TTS）系统虽已扩展语言覆盖范围，但其在复杂文本输入下的鲁棒性仍缺乏充分诊断。现有评估主要聚焦于自然度、说话人相似性和内容一致性，使用常规测试句，难以揭示多语言TTS系统在处理数字、日期、命名实体、长句、代码切换表达及与标点相关的结构等挑战性输入时的失败机制。本文提出一种针对低资源多语言TTS的复杂文本鲁棒性诊断框架。从内容一致性、语言一致性和生成稳定性三个维度评估鲁棒性。设计了涵盖泰语、越南语、斯瓦希里语和印尼语的多语言鲁棒性测试方案，覆盖普通句子和多种复杂文本输入类型。进一步引入自动诊断指标，包括字符错误率、语言识别准确率和时长异常率。为支持语音生成前的输入级风险分析，提出轻量级文本风险评分（TRS），通过可解释的文本特征估计合成风险，无需人工标注或模型训练。在OmniVoice、VoxCPM2和MMS-TTS三类代表性多语言TTS系统上的实验表明，复杂文本输入暴露了系统性失败模式，这些模式在普通短句评估中无法完全体现。不同系统在数字归一化、命名实体处理、长文本生成和代码切换输入处理方面表现出不同的脆弱性。此外，TRS与内容错误和时长异常呈正相关，证明其作为低资源多语言TTS中复杂文本风险诊断的低成本预合成指标具有实用性。

summary: Efficient language learning requires methods to reduce the reliance on large data and computational resources. We investigate structural transfer: First training models on non-language data to induce useful priors for natural language. This approach is a form of weight initialization for multilingual language modeling. We evaluate transfer via next-token-prediction loss, weight shifts in the model, and downstream linguistic benchmarks. Several symbolic data types - notably music, probabilistic grammars, and cellular automata - yield lower language-modeling loss than random initialization. These gains coincide with smaller weight shifts during subsequent language training, suggesting that structural transfer positions models in a more favorable region of the parameter space. However, a lower loss does not translate consistently into better downstream linguistic performance, and transfer from non-language data is less efficient than additional language data. We conclude that non-language data can serve as a partial substitute for language data for the training objective of next-token prediction but does not reliably support broader linguistic generalization.
title: Structural priors for data-efficient language learning
title_translated: 数据高效语言学习的结构先验
summary_translated: 高效语言学习需要减少对大规模数据和计算资源的依赖。我们研究结构迁移：首先在非语言数据上训练模型，以诱导对自然语言有用的先验知识。这种方法是一种多语言语言建模的权重初始化方式。我们通过下一个词预测损失、模型权重偏移以及下游语言基准来评估迁移效果。几种符号数据类型——特别是音乐、概率语法和细胞自动机——相比随机初始化，能带来更低的语言建模损失。这些收益与后续语言训练期间较小的权重偏移一致，表明结构迁移将模型置于参数空间中更有利的位置。然而，较低的损失并不总是转化为更好的下游语言性能，且从非语言数据迁移的效率低于额外的语言数据。我们得出结论：非语言数据可部分替代语言数据用于下一个词预测的训练目标，但不能可靠地支持更广泛的语言泛化。

summary: Reviewer comments naturally relate to specific parts of the reviewed paper, yet grounding these comments to the underlying evidence is difficult due to long multimodal documents. Existing benchmarks do not capture this setting and largely focus on explicit, information-seeking queries. We introduce ReGround, a large-scale dataset for reviewer comment grounding that links 10,267 reviewer comments to 16,274 evidence in the original anonymous submission of 3,656 papers. We build on a simple observation: author rebuttals often include explicit references to content of the submission used to address reviewer comments, providing a high-precision annotation source. We cast grounding as a retrieval task and evaluate a wide range of retrieval methods. Results show that retrieval over the entire paper content performs poorly, evidence-type inference is a major bottleneck, and multimodal evidence provides complementary signals that text alone misses. Our dataset exposes grounding reviewer comments as a difficult and practically important problem for scientific document understanding.
title: ReGround: Grounding Reviewer Comments in Multimodal Evidence
title_translated: ReGround：在多模态证据中定位审稿意见
summary_translated: 审稿意见自然关联到论文的具体部分，但由于长篇多模态文档的存在，将这些意见与底层证据进行定位十分困难。现有基准未能捕捉这一场景，且大多聚焦于明确的信息查询任务。我们引入ReGround，一个大规模的审稿意见定位数据集，将10,267条审稿意见与3,656篇论文原始匿名投稿中的16,274个证据进行关联。我们基于一个简单观察：作者反驳中经常包含对用于回应审稿意见的投稿内容的显式引用，这提供了一个高精度的标注来源。我们将定位任务视为检索任务，并评估了多种检索方法。结果表明，对整篇论文内容进行检索表现不佳，证据类型推断是主要瓶颈，而多模态证据提供了文本单独无法捕捉的互补信号。我们的数据集揭示了审稿意见定位是一个困难且具有实际重要性的科学文档理解问题。

summary: Background: To determine whether cross-lingual clinical annotation projection can be formulated as a text-preserving, document-level generative task that produces verifiable character-level annotations for multilingual clinical corpus construction, and to characterize its robustness and computational trade-offs relative to candidate-based projection pipelines. Methods: We developed a constrained LLM projection workflow that inserts entity tags directly into immutable target-language text, followed by deterministic validation and character-offset reconstruction. We evaluated it alongside supervised candidate-span projection and hybrid ML-LLM refinement for transferring Spanish Disease, Symptom, and Procedure annotations into six languages. Evaluation used MultiClinAI gold standard with strict span matching and character-overlap F1 Results: Direct LLM projection achieved the strongest and most consistent performance. GLM 5.2 obtained a mean Strict F1 of 0.9201 across 18 language-entity combinations, while locally deployable Gemma4:31B achieved 0.9133. The best LLM configuration improved Strict F1 over the previous state of the art in all 18 settings, by 0.0564-0.1512, yielding 55,416 grounded mentions with reconstructed offsets. Conclusions: Direct LLM-based projection enables high-quality multilingual clinical annotation transfer and provides a practical approach for extending clinical NLP resources to languages with fewer annotated datasets and language-specific tools. Combined with local inference and deterministic validation, it can substantially reduce expert time and cost for multilingual clinical corpus construction.
title: Cross-Lingual Clinical Annotation Projection as Constrained Text Generation: A Six-Language Study

title_translated: 跨语言临床注释投影作为约束文本生成：一项六语言研究
summary_translated: 背景：为确定跨语言临床注释投影是否可被表述为一种保持文本、文档级的生成任务，该任务能生成可验证的字符级注释以构建多语言临床语料库，并表征其相对于基于候选的投影流程的鲁棒性与计算权衡。方法：我们开发了一种受约束的大型语言模型（LLM）投影工作流，直接将实体标签插入不可变的目标语言文本中，随后进行确定性验证和字符偏移重建。我们在转移西班牙语疾病、症状和操作注释至六种语言时，评估了该方法与监督式候选跨度投影及混合机器学习-大型语言模型精炼方法的表现。评估使用MultiClinAI黄金标准，采用严格的跨度匹配和字符重叠F1指标。结果：直接LLM投影实现了最强且最一致的性能。GLM 5.2在18个语言-实体组合上的平均严格F1达到0.9201，而本地部署的Gemma4:31B达到0.9133。最佳LLM配置在所有18个设置中均优于先前最优水平，提升幅度为0.0564–0.1512，生成了55,416个带有重构偏移的可靠提及。结论：基于直接LLM的投影能够实现高质量的多语言临床注释迁移，并为扩展资源较少或缺乏特定语言工具的语言的临床自然语言处理资源提供实用方法。结合本地推理与确定性验证，可显著减少多语言临床语料库构建中的专家时间和成本。

summary: Large language models exhibit complementary strengths, motivating routing methods that dispatch each query to the most suitable model. Although existing routers are effective in single-turn settings, they do not directly transfer to multi-turn dialogue, where routing performance critically depends on how historical context is segmented, retained, and incorporated into the current prompt. This introduces two fundamental challenges: preventing information loss and information confusion during context construction, and evaluating routing quality without conflating model selection with prompt construction quality. In this paper, we propose SWRouter, a Similarity-Contractive Window Router for multi-turn large language model routing. SWRouter combines a similarity-based context segmentation mechanism for prompt construction with a dual-metric evaluation framework that decouples construction accuracy from router performance. Experiments on multi-turn dialogue benchmarks demonstrate that SWRouter consistently surpasses strong baselines, achieving a 16.26% improvement in evaluation accuracy over the best individual large language model and an additional 8.22% gain over the Conv-ID Context baseline. Our results highlight that multi-turn large language model routing requires a joint design of context construction and evaluation, rather than a direct extension of single-turn routing methods.
title: SWRouter: Similarity-Contractive Window Routing for Multi-Turn Large Language Model Conversations
title_translated: SWRouter：用于多轮大语言模型对话的相似性收缩窗口路由
summary_translated: 大型语言模型展现出互补优势，促使人们提出将每个查询分配给最合适模型的路由方法。尽管现有路由器在单轮场景中表现有效，但无法直接应用于多轮对话，其中路由性能关键取决于历史上下文如何被分割、保留并融入当前提示。这带来了两个基本挑战：防止上下文构建过程中的信息丢失与信息混淆，以及在不混淆模型选择与提示构建质量的情况下评估路由质量。本文提出SWRouter，一种用于多轮大语言模型路由的相似性收缩窗口路由器。SWRouter结合基于相似性的上下文分割机制用于提示构建，以及一个双指标评估框架，将构建准确性与路由器性能解耦。在多轮对话基准上的实验表明，SWRouter始终优于强基线，在评估准确率上比最佳单一大型语言模型高出16.26%，比Conv-ID Context基线再提升8.22%。我们的结果强调，多轮大语言模型路由需要联合设计上下文构建与评估机制，而非简单扩展单轮路由方法。

summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for machine translation, yet their outputs often contain additional text beyond the translation itself, such as language labels, explanations or bilingual repetitions, which we term translation noise. Despite its prevalence, this problem lacks dedicated benchmarks and systematic study. We analyze over 790,000 translation outputs from 12 LLMs across 22 language pairs (LPs) and identify 12 recurring noise patterns, which we group into formatting and content noise. Building on the observed patterns, we construct TransClean, a controlled benchmark of 9,900 pairs of noisy and clean translation outputs, comprising 8,800 synthetically generated instances and 1,100 manually curated authentic instances. We evaluate two extraction approaches on the TransClean benchmark: 1) a span-based extraction method leveraging translation quality estimation models for span detection, and 2) an LLM-based extraction method that prompts an LLM to isolate the translation. Our benchmark and analysis provide the first systematic framework to evaluate and improve the cleanliness of LLM translation outputs.
title: TransClean: A Benchmark for Detecting and Extracting Clean Translations from Large Language Model Outputs
comment: Accepted to the Eleventh Conference on Machine Translation (WMT26)
title_translated: TransClean：检测与提取大语言模型输出中干净翻译的基准测试
summary_translated: 大型语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地用于机器翻译，但其输出常包含翻译本身之外的额外文本，如语言标签、解释或双语重复等，我们称之为翻译噪声。尽管此类问题普遍存在，却缺乏专门的基准和系统性研究。我们分析了来自12个LLM在22个语言对上的超过79万条翻译输出，识别出12种常见的噪声模式，并将其归类为格式噪声和内容噪声。基于观察到的模式，我们构建了TransClean，一个包含9,900对噪声与干净翻译输出的受控基准，其中包括8,800个合成生成实例和1,100个手动标注的真实实例。我们在TransClean基准上评估了两种提取方法：1）利用翻译质量估计模型进行跨度检测的基于跨度的方法；2）通过提示LLM来隔离翻译的基于LLM的方法。我们的基准与分析提供了首个系统性框架，用于评估和改进LLM翻译输出的纯净度。

summary: This paper describes our system for Task~2 of the second Multilingual Conversational Speech Language Model (MLC-SLM) Challenge. We adapt Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B-Instruct with a segment-evidence-aware data and post-training pipeline. A language model converts timestamped ASR into coherent event spans, which are expanded by a boundary margin and cropped from the original recording. We then synthesize complementary semantic MCQs with Qwen3.6-27B and acoustic MCQs with Gemini~3.1 Flash-Lite, followed by structural, grounding, answer-consistency, and target-model trainability checks, yielding 359,825 verified MCQs across 21 language and accent variants. A text-only probe partitions the data into weak, text-answerable items used for supervised fine-tuning and strong, audio-dependent items used for reinforcement learning with Group Sequence Policy Optimization (GSPO), stabilized by debiased advantages, sequence-level importance correction, and dynamic filtering. Our system obtains 90.92% accuracy on the final official evaluation set.
title: SEAR: Segment-Evidence-Aware Routing for Weak-to-Strong Multilingual Speech MCQ
title_translated: SEAR：面向弱到强多语言语音多项选择题的段落-证据感知路由
summary_translated: 本文介绍了我们在第二届多语言对话语音语言模型（MLC-SLM）挑战赛Task~2中的系统方案。我们采用Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B-Instruct，并结合段落-证据感知的数据与后训练流程。一个语言模型将带时间戳的语音识别结果转换为连贯的事件片段，经边界扩展后从原始录音中裁剪出来。随后，我们使用Qwen3.6-27B合成互补语义多项选择题，使用Gemini~3.1 Flash-Lite生成声学多项选择题，再经过结构、定位、答案一致性及目标模型可训练性检查，最终获得359,825个经验证的多项选择题，覆盖21种语言和口音变体。一个仅基于文本的探测器将数据分为弱项（仅文本可解）用于监督微调，以及强项（依赖音频）用于基于组序列策略优化（GSPO）的强化学习，该过程通过去偏优势、序列级重要性校正和动态过滤加以稳定。我们的系统在最终官方评估集上取得了90.92%的准确率。

summary: As large language models are increasingly deployed in sensitive domains, anonymizing input data to protect personally identifiable information has become a critical practice. However, the impact of this anonymization on model utility is not well understood. This paper presents a systematic empirical study of the trade-off between privacy and performance. We evaluate five prominent language models across eleven diverse benchmarks, comparing their performance on original versus pseudonymized inputs. Our results reveal that while anonymization generally degrades performance, the effect is highly nuanced. We find that more capable models, such as Qwen2.5-72B and GPT-4o mini, suffer the largest performance drops, suggesting a stronger reliance on specific entity information. The impact is also task-dependent: performance on TruthfulQA improves with anonymization, while retrieval-focused tasks like RGB experience a catastrophic decline. Further experiments show that reversible anonymization techniques that preserve entity uniqueness significantly outperform irreversible ones like redaction, and that explicitly prompting models about anonymization offers no discernible benefit. We conclude that anonymization is not a one-size-fits-all solution and must be co-designed with the model and task in mind to balance privacy and utility effectively. Our findings provide a crucial baseline for developing more robust, privacy-aware AI systems.
title: On the Impact of Anonymization on the Performance of Large Language Models
title_translated: 匿名化对大语言模型性能影响的研究
summary_translated: 随着大语言模型在敏感领域中的日益应用，对输入数据进行匿名化以保护个人身份信息已成为关键实践。然而，这种匿名化对模型效用的影响尚不明确。本文系统地研究了隐私与性能之间的权衡。我们在十一个多样化的基准上评估了五个主流语言模型，比较其在原始输入与伪匿名化输入下的表现。结果表明，虽然匿名化通常会降低性能，但影响高度复杂。我们发现，更强大的模型（如Qwen2.5-72B和GPT-4o mini）遭受最大的性能下降，表明其对特定实体信息的更强依赖。影响还具有任务依赖性：在TruthfulQA任务上，匿名化反而提升了性能，而在以检索为核心的RGB任务上则出现灾难性下降。进一步实验显示，保留实体唯一性的可逆匿名化技术显著优于不可逆的删除方式，而显式提示模型关于匿名化并无明显益处。我们得出结论：匿名化并非放之四海而皆准的解决方案，必须与模型和任务共同设计，才能有效平衡隐私与效用。我们的发现为开发更稳健、具备隐私意识的人工智能系统提供了关键基准。

summary: Natural Language Inference processes pairs of sentences to extract their semantic relations. NLI has been a hot research topic, integrated as a main component in other NLP applications. Despite significant advancements in textual inference across various languages all around the world, Arabic language still suffers from limited resources in this domain. To address this gap, this paper introduces E-CONAN benchmarks that are composed of sentences pairs from various sources: (1) automatically-translated pairs, (2) human-validated machine-translated pairs, (3) hand-crafted pairs from teaching Arabic as foreign language books, and (4) headlines pairs from different news channels containing rumors. E-CONAN contains two benchmark datasets, E-CONAN-2, a 2-way dataset (RTE) and E-CONAN-3, a 3-way dataset (NLI). Additionally, we have used E-CONAN benchmarks to evaluate 9 state-of-the-art multilingual pretrained models using zero-shot classification. Models were evaluated across the ArNLI, XNLI, and E-CONAN datasets. Results show that E-CONAN is a potentially valuable resource for evaluating model generalization and even for fine-tuning pre-trained models. Its diverse composition, derived from a combination of sources, offers a broader and more robust assessment compared to XNLI and ArNLI. In addition, we have evaluated 5 LLMs on E-CONAN-3 dataset. Moreover, we incorporated MARBERT as a representative Arabic-specific baseline and conducted performance evaluation comparison to demonstrate how Arabic-specific models scale against cross-lingual and LLM-based approaches on the E-CONAN benchmarks. Furthermore, we conducted detailed qualitative and quantitative error analysis to analyze frequent error patterns. E-CONAN benchmarks will be publicly available, we hope that it will enrich research community in Arabic textual entailment and natural language inference.
title: E-CONAN (Entailment, CONtradition And Neutral) Benchmarks: Arabic Textual Entailment and Natural Inference Datasets
title_translated: E-CONAN（蕴含、矛盾与中立）基准：阿拉伯语文本蕴含与自然推理数据集
summary_translated: 自然语言推理（NLI）旨在分析句子对之间的语义关系，是自然语言处理中的热门研究方向，并被广泛集成于其他NLP应用中。尽管全球多种语言在文本推理方面取得了显著进展，但阿拉伯语在此领域仍面临资源匮乏的问题。为填补这一空白，本文提出了E-CONAN基准，包含来自多个来源的句子对：（1）自动翻译的句子对，（2）人工验证的机器翻译句子对，（3）以阿拉伯语作为第二语言教学书籍中的手工构造句子对，以及（4）包含谣言信息的不同新闻频道标题对。E-CONAN包含两个基准数据集：E-CONAN-2（二分类，RTE）和E-CONAN-3（三分类，NLI）。此外，我们使用E-CONAN基准评估了9个最先进的多语言预训练模型在零样本分类任务中的表现，涵盖ArNLI、XNLI和E-CONAN数据集。结果表明，E-CONAN是评估模型泛化能力甚至用于微调预训练模型的潜在宝贵资源。其多样化的构成源自多种来源的结合，相比XNLI和ArNLI提供了更广泛且更稳健的评估。我们还对5个大语言模型在E-CONAN-3数据集上进行了评估，并引入MARBERT作为代表性的阿拉伯语专用基线模型，通过性能对比展示阿拉伯语专用模型与跨语言及基于LLM方法在E-CONAN基准上的表现差异。此外，我们进行了详细的定性和定量错误分析，以识别常见错误模式。E-CONAN基准将公开发布，我们希望它能丰富阿拉伯语文本蕴含与自然语言推理领域的研究。

summary: Computational recognition of verbal humour remains a challenging task, requiring an understanding of language, delivery style, emotions, and cultural context. Most existing approaches focus on binary classification and lack datasets that capture psychological dimensions of humour alongside variations in expression. We introduce MultiHuSE, a multimodal dataset comprising 2,407 high-definition videos of 50 demographically diverse actors performing 1,463 text samples across four psychological humour styles (affiliative, aggressive, self-enhancing, and self-deprecating), as well as neutral content. A subset is additionally annotated for underlying emotions. The dataset uniquely captures multiple actor interpretations of the same texts, enabling systematic analysis of expressive diversity. Baseline experiments show that multimodal fusion outperforms unimodal approaches (80.1% vs. 77.4% accuracy) in humour style classification, with particularly strong gains for affiliative humour (66% to 74%). While text provides the strongest individual signal, fusion models deliver meaningful improvements. We hope that MultiHuSE provides empirical support for psychological theories linking humour and emotion, while also opening new avenues for research in human communication, well-being, and AI-driven interaction. The dataset is available for academic use under an End-User Licence Agreement.
title: MultiHuSE: A Multimodal Dataset for Humour Styles and Emotions
comment: 7 pages, 3 figures, 5 tables. Accepted at IEEE CBMI 2025 (International Conference on Content-Based Multimedia Indexing), Dublin, Ireland
title_translated: MultiHuSE：幽默风格与情绪的多模态数据集
summary_translated: 言语幽默的计算识别仍是一项具有挑战性的任务，需要理解语言、表达风格、情绪以及文化背景。现有大多数方法集中于二分类任务，缺乏能够捕捉幽默心理维度及其表达变化的数据集。本文提出MultiHuSE，一个包含2,407段高清视频的多模态数据集，由50位人口统计学特征多样化的演员表演1,463个文本样本，涵盖四种心理幽默风格（亲和型、攻击型、自我提升型、自我贬损型）以及中性内容。部分数据集还额外标注了底层情绪。该数据集独特之处在于捕捉了同一文本由多位演员的不同演绎方式，从而支持对表达多样性的系统性分析。基线实验显示，多模态融合方法在幽默风格分类中优于单模态方法（准确率80.1% vs. 77.4%），尤其在亲和型幽默上提升显著（从66%提升至74%）。虽然文本提供最强的单一信号，但融合模型仍带来实质性改进。我们期望MultiHuSE能为连接幽默与情绪的心理学理论提供实证支持，同时为人类交流、福祉及AI驱动交互研究开辟新路径。该数据集可依最终用户许可协议用于学术用途。

summary: Automatic Lyric Transcription (ALT) remains substantially more challenging than speech recognition due to melodic variability, rhythmic irregularity, and accompaniment interference. This is heightened in low-resource languages like Greek, where no prior benchmark for ALT exists. We present the first controlled study of Whisper adaptation for Greek ALT, investigating model scaling effects, task composition via multitask training in transcribe-translate ratios, and two-stage speech-to-singing adaptation. We also curate a segment-level aligned singing dataset based on the Greek Audio Dataset (GAD) using source separation and CTC forced alignment. Results show that scaling consistently improves performance, while multitask learning acts as a beneficial regularizer primarily for smaller-capacity models. The 2-stage adaptation in Whisper Large-v3 achieves a Word Error Rate (WER) of 27.2%, a significant improvement over zero-shot baselines, establishing the first Greek ALT benchmark.
title: Automatic Lyric Transcription for Greek Songs: Scaling and Task Composition Effects in Whisper Adaptation
title_translated: 希腊语歌曲歌词自动转录：Whisper适配中的规模效应与任务组合影响
summary_translated: 自动歌词转录（ALT）相较于语音识别仍面临更大挑战，主要源于旋律变化、节奏不规则以及伴奏干扰。这一挑战在低资源语言如希腊语中尤为突出，此前尚无相关基准。本文首次系统研究了Whisper模型在希腊语ALT任务中的适应性，考察了模型规模效应、通过多任务训练中转录-翻译比例进行的任务组合设计，以及两阶段语音到歌唱的适配策略。同时，我们基于希腊音频数据集（GAD）利用源分离和CTC强制对齐技术构建了一个分段级对齐的歌唱数据集。结果表明，模型规模扩大能持续提升性能，而多任务学习对小容量模型起到了有益的正则化作用。采用两阶段适配的Whisper Large-v3模型实现了27.2%的词错误率（WER），显著优于零样本基线，确立了首个希腊语ALT基准。

summary: Multimodal Sentiment Analysis (MSA) remains constrained by modality imbalance, yet the field continues to rely on optimization-based balancing methods that promise more than they deliver. We provide three contributions: 1) a unified evaluation framework testing gradient and loss-based balancing strategies under controlled settings; 2) a theoretical diagnosis explaining why these methods fail, as they conflate fitting speed with discriminative contribution; and 3) a research agenda toward held-out discriminative modality valuation. Experiments on CMU-MOSI and CMU-MOSEI reveal three shortcomings: no strategy reliably outperforms Late Concatenation; performance is sensitive to hyperparameters; and even ratio calibration fails to yield consistent gains. The core issue is fundamental: loss is not utility, and gradients are not importance. Modality imbalance remains unresolved, motivating utility estimation from held-out performance.
title: The Illusion of Balanced Multimodal Sentiment Analysis: Beyond the Limits of Optimization-Based Methods
title_translated: 平衡多模态情感分析的幻觉：超越基于优化方法的局限
summary_translated: 多模态情感分析（MSA）仍受模态不平衡问题制约，但该领域持续依赖基于优化的平衡方法，这些方法承诺的效果远未实现。本文提出三项贡献：1）一个统一的评估框架，在受控条件下测试梯度与损失层面的平衡策略；2）理论诊断，解释为何这些方法失效——因其混淆了拟合速度与判别贡献；3）面向保留判别模态估值的研究议程。在CMU-MOSI和CMU-MOSEI数据集上的实验揭示三个缺陷：无一种策略能稳定超越晚期拼接（Late Concatenation）；性能对超参数敏感；即使比例校准也无法带来一致收益。核心问题在于根本性的误解：损失并非效用，梯度亦非重要性。模态不平衡仍未解决，因此需从保留性能中估计效用。

summary: Kurdish is spoken by millions of people, but little technology can read it aloud. A recent study released three Kurdish voices, 35 hours of recorded speech, and a paper describing the work, all free to download. This review checks how well those public files match the paper. The research is careful about its limits, but the files contain several problems: a settings file lists equipment that was never used, test recordings are left unlabeled among training data, and a coding fault mishandles long numbers. The download page also claims a stronger result than the paper reports and recommends one voice for general use. That recommendation matters because Kurdish has major regional and written variation, while these voices were built from three people reading prepared texts. The process therefore removes much everyday and regional speech. English and German benefit from long traditions of dictionaries and linguistic description that help identify wrong pronunciations; Kurdish has far less such support, so software choices can go unchecked. The voices sound fluent, but they represent the reading styles of their speakers rather than Kurdish as a whole. Most of these issues can be fixed using information the team already has, without changing the reported results. Better records would mainly make the work easier for others, especially community linguists, to check and reuse. The license is the main exception: whether audiobook owners allow corrected versions to be shared will affect whether future Kurdish voices can build on this work or must start again.
title: Assessing the Reusability of Public Speech Resources for Low-Resource Languages: A Central Kurdish Case Study
title_translated: 评估公共语音资源在低资源语言中的可重用性：以库尔德语（中央库尔德语）为例的研究
summary_translated: 库尔德语有数百万使用者，但目前很少有技术能实现其语音朗读。近期一项研究发布了三个库尔德语语音样本、35小时录音以及一篇描述工作的论文，全部免费下载。本研究审查了这些公开文件与论文描述的匹配程度。研究谨慎指出其局限性，但发现文件中存在若干问题：设置文件列出了从未使用的设备，测试录音混杂在训练数据中未标记，编码错误导致长数字处理异常。下载页面还声称比论文报告的结果更强，并推荐某一语音用于通用场景。这一推荐至关重要，因为库尔德语存在重大地区与书写变体，而这些语音仅来自三人朗读准备好的文本，因而缺失大量日常与地区性口语表达。英语和德语得益于长期字典与语言描述传统，有助于识别发音错误；而库尔德语缺乏此类支持，导致软件选择难以被检验。这些语音听起来流畅，但仅代表其说话者的朗读风格，而非库尔德语整体。大多数问题可通过团队已有的信息修复，无需更改报告结果。更完善的记录主要使他人（尤其是社区语言学家）更容易核查与复用。唯一例外是许可证：是否允许分享修正版本取决于有声书版权持有者，这将决定未来库尔德语音频能否在此基础上发展，还是必须重新开始。

summary: While Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have achieved remarkable progress across diverse tasks, they suffer from hallucinations where generated outputs contradict or misrepresent input semantics. Existing research typically addresses hallucination detection within a single modality or task type, limiting generalizability. We introduce OmniHallu, a unified hallucination detection framework spanning both comprehension and generation tasks across image, video, and audio modalities. We contribute OmniHallu-Bench, a 10,000-sample benchmark with claim-level human annotations covering six cross-modal tasks: image-to-text (I2T), video-to-text (V2T), audio-to-text (A2T), text-to-image (T2I), text-to-video (T2V), and text-to-audio (T2A). Our multi-agent architecture decomposes model outputs into atomic claims, verifies them through modality-specific experts, and aggregates evidence via structured reasoning. We further propose a preference-optimized trainable verifier that approximates the multi-agent decision boundary, reducing expert calls by 66% with minimal performance loss. Extensive experiments reveal a consistent modality-dependent performance gradient and provide fine-grained insights into cross-modal hallucination patterns.
title: OmniHallu: Unified Hallucination Detection for Cross-Modal Comprehension and Generation in Multimodal Large Language Models
comment: Accepted to Findings of EMNLP 2026. 12 pages, 4 figures
title_translated: OmniHallu：多模态大语言模型跨模态理解与生成中的统一幻觉检测
summary_translated: 尽管多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在各类任务中取得了显著进展，但其生成结果常出现与输入语义矛盾或歪曲的幻觉现象。现有研究通常仅针对单一模态或任务类型进行幻觉检测，限制了泛化能力。我们提出OmniHallu，一个覆盖图像、视频和音频模态的跨模态理解与生成任务的统一幻觉检测框架。我们构建了OmniHallu-Bench基准，包含10,000个样本，涵盖六种跨模态任务（图像到文本、视频到文本、音频到文本、文本到图像、文本到视频、文本到音频），并提供逐声明的人工标注。我们的多智能体架构将模型输出分解为原子命题，通过模态特定专家进行验证，并利用结构化推理聚合证据。我们进一步提出一种偏好优化的可训练验证器，近似多智能体决策边界，在减少66%专家调用的情况下仅带来微小性能损失。大量实验揭示了明显的模态依赖性性能梯度，并提供了对跨模态幻觉模式的细粒度洞察。

summary: Social media platforms have become central to shaping political discourse, serving as arenas where narratives form and evolve, influencing public opinion. Identifying and analyzing these narratives, particularly when they compete across different political ideologies, is crucial for understanding the dynamics of modern political communication. This paper presents an unsupervised framework for identifying and characterizing competing narratives in political discourse on social media, focusing on German politicians' tweets. The framework employs a multi-stage pipeline that integrates natural language processing techniques such as topic modeling, event detection, and event linking. By forming data into coherent stories and uncovering the distinct perspectives of user communities, the system is able to detect the key competing narratives, highlighting the divergent framings and conflicts surrounding trending political topics. Two case studies on polarizing political issues demonstrate the efficacy of the methodology, showcasing its ability to uncover and analyze divergent viewpoints. The findings contribute to the broader understanding of how narratives propagate within the digital public sphere and offer insights for policymakers, social media platforms, and researchers interested in monitoring political discourse.
title: Automated Identification of Competing Narratives in Political Discourse on Social Media
comment: 11 pages, 5 figures. Published in the proceedings of Text2Story 2025, held with ECIR 2025
title_translated: 社交媒体政治话语中竞争叙事的自动化识别
summary_translated: 社交媒体平台已成为塑造政治话语的核心场域，是叙事形成与演变的重要空间，深刻影响公众意见。识别并分析不同政治意识形态之间的竞争性叙事，对于理解现代政治传播动态至关重要。本文提出一种无监督框架，用于识别和刻画社交媒体上政治话语中的竞争叙事，聚焦德国政客的推文。该框架采用多阶段流程，整合自然语言处理技术如主题建模、事件检测与事件关联。通过将数据组织成连贯的故事，揭示用户社区的不同视角，系统能够检测出关键的竞争性叙事，突出热点政治议题背后的分歧框架与冲突。两个关于极化政治议题的案例研究证明了该方法的有效性，展示了其揭示与分析分歧观点的能力。研究成果有助于深化对数字公共领域中叙事传播机制的理解，并为政策制定者、社交媒体平台及研究人员提供监控政治话语的洞见。

summary: Soft context compression condenses a context into a few memory tokens that a frozen LLM consumes in place of the raw text, but existing compressors fix the compression ratio at training and inference: each deployed ratio requires a separately trained model, and the chosen ratio is applied uniformly to all inputs, whose actual needs vary drastically. We propose FlexComp, a method-agnostic framework that decouples the ratio from both training and deployment: Matryoshka-style training samples the memory budget $K$ per instance, turning one model into an any-ratio compressor, and the budget is then chosen per input by: (1) confidence-based cascade routing or (2) a lightweight learned $K$ predictor. Across ICAE, 500xCompressor, and SAC on MRQA, a single FlexComp model matches separately trained fixed-ratio specialists with minimal degradation. Cascade routing preserves over 98% of the mildest ratio's accuracy at up to 266x average compression; the $K$ predictor, in a single compression-decoding pass, reaches 158-236x within 0.7 F1 of the mildest ratio. At serving-scale batch sizes, the $K$ predictor cuts context KV cache by 50% and improves decoding throughput by 47%.
title: FlexComp: One Model for Every Ratio in Context Compression
title_translated: FlexComp：适用于上下文压缩中任意比率的统一模型
summary_translated: 软上下文压缩将上下文浓缩为少量记忆标记，由冻结的大语言模型替代原始文本进行处理，但现有压缩器在训练和推理时固定压缩比率：每个部署比率需单独训练模型，且所选比率对所有输入均一适用，而实际需求差异巨大。我们提出FlexComp，一种与方法无关的框架，将比率从训练和部署中解耦：Matryoshka风格的训练按实例采样内存预算$K$，使单一模型成为任意比率的压缩器；随后根据输入选择预算：(1) 基于置信度的级联路由，或 (2) 轻量级学习的$K$预测器。在ICAE、500xCompressor和SAC on MRQA任务上，单个FlexComp模型与分别训练的固定比率专用模型性能相当，仅略有下降。级联路由在平均266倍压缩下保持超过98%最轻压缩比率的准确率；$K$预测器在一次压缩-解码过程中实现158-236倍压缩，F1值仅比最轻比率低0.7。在服务规模批量处理下，$K$预测器将上下文KV缓存减少50%，解码吞吐量提升47%。

summary: Model-generated text is finding its way back into training corpora, and there is plenty of evidence that training on such data over and over collapses output diversity. Prior work has studied the phenomenon itself: which protocols and which data mixtures cause collapse. But different models behave very differently under the same process. We fix one recursive contamination protocol and let 13 publicly released checkpoints form an ecosystem that shares a common corpus for five generations. The unique 4-gram outcome after five generations ranges from 0.187 to 0.940 across checkpoints, a roughly five-fold spread: some models are barely touched, others degenerate into repetitive fragments. Changing the composition of the shared pool or mixing in human text keeps the Spearman correlation of the ordering at 0.91--0.97, and changing the random seed keeps it at 0.93--0.98. Whether a model collapses easily under recursive training is, then, a property of the checkpoint itself, and one that has gone largely unexamined. Parameter scale alone does not explain it, since a three-size ladder within one family is not monotonic in size, and none of the static indicators we tested predicts it either. What does work is cheap: let a model iterate on its own output for two or three generations, and its fragility in the larger ecosystem can be inferred from that alone. Collapse speed also responds to intervention. Tightening top-p, which cuts the low-probability tail at generation time, nearly stops collapse within three generations and stabilizes six checkpoints spanning the whole spectrum together, while data-side filtering slows collapse without stopping it.
title: A Fragility Spectrum for Recursive Language-Model Training
title_translated: 递归语言模型训练的脆弱性谱系
summary_translated: 模型生成的文本正不断回流至训练语料库，已有大量证据表明反复使用此类数据会破坏输出多样性。先前研究关注该现象本身：哪些协议和数据混合会导致崩溃。但不同模型在同一过程下的表现差异极大。我们固定一种递归污染协议，让13个公开发布的检查点共同构成一个生态系统，共享同一语料库进行五代迭代。五代后唯一4-gram结果范围从0.187到0.940，相差约五倍：部分模型几乎未受影响，另一些则退化为重复片段。改变共享池组成或引入人工文本，仍保持排序的Spearman相关性在0.91–0.97之间；改变随机种子也维持在0.93–0.98。因此，模型在递归训练中是否易崩溃，是检查点自身的属性，且长期被忽视。参数规模无法解释此现象，因为同一家族内三档规模并非单调变化，且我们测试的所有静态指标也无法预测。真正有效的方法极为简单：让模型对其自身输出迭代两到三代，即可据此推断其在更大生态系统中的脆弱性。崩溃速度也可通过干预调控：收紧top-p（生成时截断低概率尾部）可在三代内几乎完全阻止崩溃，并稳定整个谱系的六个检查点；而数据侧过滤虽能延缓崩溃，却无法彻底阻止。

summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used to generate structured outputs, but their reliability remains unclear when those outputs must satisfy database-level constraints. We study this issue through database normalization, involving reasoning about functional dependencies, lossless join decompositions, and inter-table constraints. We introduce a Database Normalization Benchmark (DNBENCH), comprising 3,275 samples for evaluating LLM-driven database normalization from 1NF to BCNF. DNBENCH uses a three-axis protocol to measure semantic equivalence, structural accuracy, and logical validity. Across Single, Complex, and Real World levels, DNBENCH uncovers recurring failures in dependency inference, schema decomposition, and inter-table constraint reconstruction. We further propose Multi-Agent Reasoning for Schemas (MARS), which separates evidence extraction, violation diagnosis, and decomposition planning from schema generation and verification. MARS improves the DNB-SCORE by 82.0% over the single-prompt baseline. All artifacts will be released upon acceptance.
title: Can LLMs Normalize Databases? A Benchmark and Multi-Agent Framework for Schema Normalization
title_translated: 大语言模型能否实现数据库规范化？面向模式规范化的基准与多智能体框架
summary_translated: 大语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地用于生成结构化输出，但当这些输出必须满足数据库层面约束时，其可靠性仍不明确。我们通过数据库规范化问题研究这一挑战，涉及函数依赖推理、无损连接分解及表间约束。我们引入数据库规范化基准（DNBENCH），包含3,275个样本，用于评估从1NF到BCNF的LLM驱动数据库规范化。DNBENCH采用三轴协议衡量语义等价性、结构准确性和逻辑有效性。在单层、复杂和真实世界三个层级上，DNBENCH揭示了依赖推理、模式分解和表间约束重建中的重复失败。我们进一步提出多智能体模式推理（MARS），将证据提取、违规诊断与分解规划与模式生成及验证分离。MARS相比单提示基线，使DNB-SCORE提升82.0%。所有相关成果将在论文接受后公开发布。

summary: Human simultaneous interpreting (SI) is commonly assessed with analytic rubrics separating meaning transfer, delivery quality, and temporal synchrony, yet no automatic metric is designed for rubric-aligned segment-level SI evaluation. We construct a professionally annotated corpus of 1,101 SI segments with scores for meaning transfer (LQ), delivery quality (EXP), and perceived latency (LAT). We show that structured LLM prompting and scalar supervision collapse rubric dimensions, yielding near-zero correlation with human ratings and strong cross-dimension coupling. To isolate supervision structure under identical backbone capacity, we introduce dual regression heads on a LoRA-adapted COMET-KIWI encoder. On a held-out talk-level test set, the model achieves Pearson correlations of 0.388 (LQ) and 0.301 (EXP), improving over frozen COMET-KIWI. Given low absolute rater agreement, we interpret results relative to human consistency and target stable ranking signals for formative assessment.
title: Rubric-Aligned Disentangled Evaluation of Human Simultaneous Interpreting
title_translated: 基于评分标准解耦的人类同声传译评估
summary_translated: 人类同声传译（SI）通常通过分析性评分标准来评估意义传递、表达质量与时间同步性，但目前尚无针对评分标准对齐的逐段自动评估指标。我们构建了一个包含1,101个SI片段的专业标注语料库，涵盖意义传递（LQ）、表达质量（EXP）和感知延迟（LAT）的评分。研究发现，结构化大语言模型提示与标量监督会压缩评分维度，导致与人工评分的相关性接近零，并产生强烈的跨维度耦合。为在相同主干模型容量下隔离监督结构，我们引入了基于LoRA适配的COMET-KIWI编码器的双回归头。在保留的演讲级测试集上，该模型实现了0.388（LQ）和0.301（EXP）的皮尔逊相关系数，优于冻结的COMET-KIWI。鉴于评分者间一致性较低，我们基于人类一致性解释结果，并致力于为形成性评估提供稳定的排名信号。

summary: In disinformation datasets, narratives are often understood as recurring interpretive patterns that group texts under narrative labels. Recent work formalized narrative mining as inductively inferring narrative labels from corpora, but its evaluation stays tied to predefined taxonomies, a closed-world setting that cannot capture narratives absent from the reference labels. We introduce a three-tier evaluation framework for unsupervised narrative label generation: recovery (against a corpus's own taxonomy), mining (against external label sets), and discovery (without predefined labels). Applying it, we compare clustering-based and graph-community-based pipelines across seven disinformation datasets, with human validation of discovery on two. The two families are complementary under automated metrics, but in a corpus with two prominent topics, clustering can reduce one topic to 2% of generated labels while graph-based pipelines stay balanced. Discovery validation also reveals many singletons (narrative labels derived from single claims, 30-62% of graph outputs), which clustering cannot produce. Annotators confirm many as recognizable disinformation narratives, suggesting that in open-world discovery the repetition assumed by narrative mining may be recognized outside the corpus, not within it. We release human-validated narrative candidate labels for the Climate Obstruction and PolyNarrative datasets to support taxonomy development and dataset extension.
title: From Repetition to Recognition: Inductive Discovery of Disinformation Narratives
title_translated: 从重复到识别：虚假信息叙事的归纳发现
summary_translated: 在虚假信息数据集中，叙事常被视为将文本归类于特定标签的重复性解释模式。近期工作将叙事挖掘形式化为从语料库中归纳叙事标签，但其评估仍依赖预定义分类体系，处于封闭世界设定下，无法捕捉未出现在参考标签中的叙事。我们提出一个三层无监督叙事标签生成评估框架：恢复（针对语料库自身分类体系）、挖掘（针对外部标签集）和发现（无需预设标签）。应用该框架，我们在七个虚假信息数据集上比较了基于聚类与基于图社区的流水线，其中两个数据集进行了人工验证。自动化指标显示两类方法互补，但在包含两个显著主题的语料库中，聚类方法可将一个主题缩减至生成标签的2%，而基于图的方法保持平衡。发现验证还揭示大量孤立标签（由单一主张衍生的叙事标签，占图输出的30-62%），这是聚类方法无法生成的。标注者确认其中许多为可识别的虚假信息叙事，表明在开放世界发现中，叙事挖掘所假设的重复性可能在语料库外被识别，而非仅在内部。我们发布了气候阻挠与PolyNarrative数据集的人工验证叙事候选标签，以支持分类体系构建与数据集扩展。

summary: Reproducibility is essential to scientific progress, yet the growing volume and complexity of scientific publications make exhaustive manual verification increasingly impractical. Although recent advances in large language model (LLM) agents enable automated experiment reproduction, existing evaluations largely focus on final repositories and are typically limited to machine learning (ML). We introduce AgentActionBench, a process-oriented benchmark for evaluating agent-based experiment reproduction across ML and AI4Science domains. Our framework uses an MCP-based Action Recorder to capture agents' behaviour throughout the reproduction process and evaluates the resulting traces with paper-specific rubrics. AgentActionBench contains 150 papers, including 120 ML papers and 30 AI4Science papers. A human-annotated subset covering 10% of the benchmark provides validation data, while model-assisted augmentation expands the full benchmark to more than 10,000 rubric items. Experimental results show that current systems remain limited, with execution as the primary bottleneck. Meanwhile, the strong Pearson and Spearman correlations between model-generated and human-annotated rubrics validate the reliability of our scalable rubric-generation approach.
title: Overview of the NLPCC 2026 Shared Task 11: Agent-Based Experiment Reproduction from Scientific Papers
title_translated: NLPCC 2026 共享任务11概述：基于智能体的科学论文实验复现
summary_translated: 可复现性是科学进步的关键，但科学出版物数量与复杂性的增长使得全面手动验证日益不切实际。尽管大语言模型（LLM）智能体的最新进展使自动化实验复现成为可能，现有评估大多聚焦最终代码仓库，且通常局限于机器学习（ML）领域。我们提出AgentActionBench，一个面向跨ML与AI4Science领域的基于智能体实验复现的过程导向基准。我们的框架采用基于MCP的Action Recorder，全程记录智能体行为，并使用针对论文特性的评分标准评估生成轨迹。AgentActionBench包含150篇论文，包括120篇ML论文和30篇AI4Science论文。一个覆盖基准10%的人工标注子集提供验证数据，而模型辅助增强将完整基准扩展至超过10,000个评分条目。实验结果表明，当前系统仍受限于执行环节，为主要瓶颈。同时，模型生成与人工标注评分之间的强皮尔逊与斯皮尔曼相关性验证了我们可扩展评分生成方法的可靠性。

summary: Dispute mediation is essential for maintaining social harmony and resilience, yet developing skilled mediators is costly and time-consuming. Existing LLM-based mediation research remains limited by unrealistic task formulations, low-fidelity datasets, and coarse evaluation metrics that obscure turn-by-turn dynamics. To address these gaps, we introduce ProMediConv, a novel benchmarking framework that models mediation as a proactive, multi-stage, and party-aware dialogue process incorporating 11 mediation strategies and four party behavior pattern (BP) states. Using 972 complete real-world cases, we construct a high-fidelity mediation dataset with utterance-level annotations of strategies and BP states. Furthermore, to better assess agent impact, we propose MAD (Mean Attribute Difference), a fine-grained metric that captures BP shifts throughout the dialogue. Leveraging this framework, we establish a comprehensive benchmark by evaluating diverse models alongside our tailored baseline ProMediAgent. Extensive empirical analyses reveal critical behavioral phenomena and underscore the persistent challenges current models face in dynamic, multi-party mediation. Ultimately, ProMediConv provides a rigorous foundation and a vital quantitative standard for advancing AI-assisted conflict resolution. Our dataset and codebase are accessible at this https URL .
title: ProMediConv: Benchmarking Proactive Conversational Agents in Legal Dispute Mediation
title_translated: ProMediConv：法律纠纷调解中主动对话智能体的基准测试
summary_translated: 纠纷调解对于维护社会和谐与韧性至关重要，但培养熟练调解员成本高且耗时长。现有基于大语言模型的调解研究受限于不切实际的任务设定、低保真度数据集以及粗粒度评估指标，难以捕捉逐轮互动动态。为弥补这些不足，我们提出ProMediConv，一个新颖的基准框架，将调解建模为一种主动的、多阶段的、关注各方的对话过程，整合11种调解策略与四种当事人行为模式（BP）状态。基于972个完整的现实案例，我们构建了一个高保真调解数据集，包含策略与BP状态的逐句标注。此外，为更准确评估智能体影响，我们提出MAD（平均属性差异）这一细粒度指标，用于捕捉对话过程中BP状态的演变。借助该框架，我们通过评估多种模型与定制基线ProMediAgent建立了全面基准。广泛的实证分析揭示了关键的行为现象，并强调当前模型在动态、多方调解中面临的持续挑战。最终，ProMediConv为推进AI辅助冲突解决提供了严谨基础与重要量化标准。我们的数据集与代码库可在该链接获取。

summary: Large language models are increasingly used as judges to measure social bias in text, yet the passages they judge are often noisy, containing typos, informal spelling, and broken punctuation. The consequences of such surface noise for social bias measurement remain unclear. To investigate this question, we apply five realistic noise conditions at multiple intensity levels to 3,822 stereotype-related responses and compare the resulting bias judgments with those on the original text. We find that such surface noise does not degrade bias measurement symmetrically: it is far more likely to turn neutral judgments into biased ones than biased judgments into neutral ones, by up to a 120x margin. We further observe two non-obvious effects across four LLM judges: in the most fragile judge the distortion is at its purest at mild, realistic noise levels, where erasure is scarcest, and as judges grow robust it attenuates toward parity rather than reversing. Bias measured on noisy text is therefore systematically overestimated, most in the categories that matter most for fairness.
title: When Noise Fabricates Bias: The Fragility of LLM-as-a-Judge Bias Measurement under Noisy Text
